nodes.label:
A macro still running after this time is stopped and counts as finished. A macro started while another one runs waits for it; up to 3 runs can wait, further presses are ignored.

Standard value: 10000 ms.

For rules triggered by several keys pressed together, such as KeyJ+KeyK. All keys must go down within this time, in any order. Until then the first key is held back; if the combination does not complete, it is typed as usual. Modifiers are never held back.

Higher: the combination is easier to hit, but typing with these keys lags slightly. Applies to all rules; a rule cannot override it.

Standard value: 50 ms.
